name: genre-compiler
description: Compile a verbose genre/style document into a conforming LM-native genre skill (skill.json + SKILL.md + references source). Use when adding a new genre, converting a style reference doc into a routable genre, or refactoring an existing genre skill. Do NOT use for writing the pre-prompt shot plan (dev-director), for building H3 prompt syntax, or for editing a genre skill by hand.
